new.title: LB1 Connect to an Audiobookshelf server
steps: `make services-up` (Postgres and Keycloak), then `make dev`. The service needs `CREDENTIALS_KEY` (32 bytes base64: `openssl rand -base64 32`) beside `DATABASE_URL` to persist credentials; without it the in-memory store is wired and the start-up log says so. To reach the stub below on `127.0.0.1` it also needs `BOOK_SERVER_ALLOW_LOOPBACK=true` (D66): by default a loopback address answers `serverUnreachable`, as does a link-local or metadata address always.

A server to connect to: `npx --prefix apps/recap-api tsx apps/recap-api/tests/stubs/audiobookshelf.ts --port 13378 --token demo-token` prints `http://127.0.0.1:13378`. (Or a real Audiobookshelf the machine running the service can reach.)
A bearer token for a listener of the customers realm (the browser app's sign-in, or Keycloak's token endpoint for the synthetic listener `ines`).

Connect: ```sh curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/connection \ -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \ -d '{"connectionId":"'$(uuidgen | tr A-Z a-z)'","url":"http://127.0.0.1:13378","token":"demo-token"}' ``` Expect `201 { "connectionId", "serverUrl": "http://127.0.0.1:13378", "connectedAt" }`. Send the same body again: `200`, the same answer, and the stub's log shows no second `/api/me`. Change the token to `wrong`: `422 { "error": "tokenRejected", … }`. Point `url` at a port nothing listens on: `422 serverUnreachable`. Point it at `http://localhost:3000` (this service): `422 notAudiobookshelf` with loopback allowed, `422 serverUnreachable` without. `http://169.254.169.254`: `422 serverUnreachable`, always.

new.title: LB11 Attach an EPUB
steps: Run `make demo` (or `make try`, which loads this slice's `try-it.json`).
Sign in as the fixture listener `ada`; the screen is behind the `import-audio` flag (`VITE_FLAG_IMPORT_AUDIO=on`).
Import the three Nine Winters M4B files from **Add a book** (LB3). The card shows *Imported to your library*.
Press **Add the EPUB for better accuracy** and choose an EPUB whose contents list titles the chapters (a sample is built by `apps/recap-api/tests/fixtures/epub.ts`).
Expect: *29 of 31 chapters lined up. Chapters 7 and 22 will use the transcript.* — and the button gone.
The API: `PUT /api/books/{bookId}/ebook` with the EPUB bytes and `Authorization: Bearer …` answers 201 `{ bookId, ebookChapters, matched, unmatched, basis }`; the same bytes again answer 200.

new.title: LB2 Change settings
steps: `GET /api/settings` → the defaults: Standard, 3 days, Tomas, Wi-Fi only on, prepare-ahead on, `changedAt: null`.
`PUT /api/settings` with `{ "defaultTier": "Full", "gapThreshold": 7, "voice": "Tomas", "wifiOnly": true, "prepareAhead": false }` → 200, the same five values with `changedAt` set.
`GET /api/settings` again → those values.
`PUT` the same body → 200 and nothing new recorded.
In the browser, open `/settings`: five rows at those values; change the gap to *never*, and the status region reads "Saving…" then "Saved"; reload and it still reads *never*.
